tasks.analysis: Sleep is crucial for maintaining overall health and well-being. It repairs our bodies and gives a chance for our brains to process memories. Research shows that getting a full night of sleep within 24 hours after learning will help us remember new information better. Lack of sleep not only hurts our learning ability but also affects mood and concentration. For example, we might find it harder to focus, make decisions, and respond quickly. 睡眠对于维持整体健康与身心状态至关重要。它可以修复身体机能，同时让大脑有机会整理记忆。研究表明，在学习后的 24 小时内保证一整晚的充足睡眠，能有效提升新知识的记忆效果。睡眠不足不仅会削弱学习能力，还会影响情绪与专注力。比如，人会难以集中注意力、难以做出判断，反应速度也会变慢。
